column1: # Shape: `unclassified<TAB>path<TAB>count`.  A count may FALL freely (the row is
# then printed as STALE and asks to be lowered); a file that is not here and
# carries an unclassified swallow FAILS, and so does a count that rises.  So a new
# `|| true` or `2>/dev/null` is a decision: mark it `# swallow-ok: <reason>` or
# change the code.  Regenerate the rows with
# Why a baseline: 965 sites across 31 files is the existing corpus, and
# reclassifying it is a separate pass — four of the heaviest files are owned by a
# concurrent session (11e/09d/08/11d).  The counts are site counts for the two
# patterns; the card's `grep -c` line counts are printed beside them at run time.
